claim_summary: Damari said of the former Military Advocate General: 'Who appointed all the judges in the military courts? She did.'
resolution_notes: Date corrected from Aug. 28 to Aug. 18 after recovering a contemporaneous watchdog capture of the exact wording. Official IDF material provides strong non-social counter-evidence: military judges are selected through statutory selection committees and appointed through the defined institutional process; separate West Bank military-court material likewise does not support personal appointment of all judges by the MAG. The direct original Channel 14 segment/full interview context was re-searched again in the coordinated freshness/backfill run and remains unrecovered, so guest attribution is preserved and no verdict is forced.
media_status: Exact secondary capture/X-linked evidence surfaced, but direct original Channel 14 segment and full context remain unresolved; no substitute media package published.
